ItemID: 1; Title: SAMSUNG T7 Portable SSD 500GB - Up to 1050MB/s - USB 3.2 External Solid State Drive, Blue (MU-PC500H/AM); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for portable file transfers alongside my older desktop backup drive.
ItemID: 2; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my Alexa setup, but my recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.

ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger Alexa display interests me, but I recently bought a Show 5 and its stand.
ItemID: 5; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would consider extending my basic door alarm setup with cameras that work with Alexa.
